title: Non-text Content
description: All non-text content must have a text alternative
logic: img without alt
fix_suggestion: Add a descriptive alt attribute to every img tag

title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
description: Prerecorded audio-only and video-only content must have an alternative
logic: audio or video elements must have transcript or description
fix_suggestion: Provide a text transcript for audio-only content and a text or audio description for video-only content

title: Captions (Prerecorded)
description: Captions must be provided for prerecorded audio content in synchronized media
logic: video elements must have captions track
fix_suggestion: Add a captions track element inside the video element with a valid src pointing to a captions file

title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
description: An alternative for time-based media or audio description must be provided
logic: video must have audio description or full text alternative
fix_suggestion: Provide an audio description track or a full text alternative for all video content

title: Captions (Live)
description: Captions must be provided for all live audio content in synchronized media
logic: live video streams must have real-time captions
fix_suggestion: Use a live captioning service or real-time speech-to-text for live video streams

title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
description: Audio description must be provided for all prerecorded video content
logic: video must have audio description track
fix_suggestion: Add an audio description track to all prerecorded video content

title: Sign Language (Prerecorded)
description: Sign language interpretation must be provided for prerecorded audio content
logic: video must include sign language interpretation
fix_suggestion: Provide a sign language interpretation video alongside the main content

title: Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded)
description: Extended audio description must be provided where pauses are insufficient
logic: video must have extended audio description if standard is insufficient
fix_suggestion: Provide an extended audio description version of the video with additional pauses

title: Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
description: A full text alternative must be provided for all prerecorded synchronized media
logic: all video content must have a full text alternative
fix_suggestion: Provide a complete text transcript that includes all spoken words and visual information

title: Audio-only (Live)
description: A text alternative must be provided for live audio-only content
logic: live audio streams must have real-time text alternative
fix_suggestion: Provide a real-time text transcript or live captioning for audio-only live streams

title: Info and Relationships
description: Information and structure must be conveyed through markup
logic: inputs must have associated labels
fix_suggestion: Add a label element with a for attribute matching the input id

title: Meaningful Sequence
description: Content must be presented in a meaningful reading order
logic: DOM order must match visual reading order
fix_suggestion: Ensure the HTML source order matches the intended reading sequence without relying on CSS positioning

title: Sensory Characteristics
description: Instructions must not rely solely on sensory characteristics
logic: instructions must not use only shape color size or location
fix_suggestion: Supplement shape color size or location references with text labels

title: Orientation
description: Content must not restrict its view to a single display orientation
logic: page must not lock orientation via CSS or meta tags
fix_suggestion: Remove any CSS or JavaScript that forces a specific screen orientation

title: Identify Input Purpose
description: The purpose of input fields collecting user information must be programmatically determinable
logic: personal data inputs must have autocomplete attributes
fix_suggestion: Add appropriate autocomplete attribute values to form inputs that collect personal information

title: Identify Purpose
description: The purpose of UI components icons and regions must be programmatically determinable
logic: icons and regions must have ARIA labels or roles
fix_suggestion: Use ARIA landmarks roles and labels to identify the purpose of all UI components and regions

title: Use of Color
description: Color must not be the only means of conveying information
logic: color should not be the only means of conveying information
fix_suggestion: Use text labels or patterns alongside color to convey meaning

title: Audio Control
description: Audio that plays automatically for more than 3 seconds must be controllable
logic: auto-playing audio must have pause stop or volume control
fix_suggestion: Add controls to any audio that plays automatically or prevent auto-play entirely

title: Contrast (Minimum)
description: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
logic: text color contrast ratio must be at least 4.5:1
fix_suggestion: Increase the contrast between text color and background color

title: Resize Text
description: Text must be resizable up to 200 percent without loss of content
logic: text must remain readable when browser zoom is set to 200 percent
fix_suggestion: Use relative units like em or rem instead of fixed pixel sizes for text

title: Images of Text
description: Text must not be presented as images unless essential
logic: images containing text should be replaced with actual text
fix_suggestion: Replace images of text with actual HTML text styled with CSS

title: Contrast (Enhanced)
description: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 7:1
logic: text color contrast ratio must be at least 7:1
fix_suggestion: Increase the contrast between text color and background color to at least 7:1

title: Low or No Background Audio
description: Background audio must be low or removable
logic: background audio must be at least 20dB lower than foreground speech
fix_suggestion: Ensure background audio is at least 20dB quieter than speech or provide a way to turn it off

title: Visual Presentation
description: Users must be able to control visual presentation of text blocks
logic: text blocks must allow foreground background color width alignment and line spacing control
fix_suggestion: Provide user controls or CSS variables to allow customization of text presentation

title: Images of Text (No Exception)
description: Text must only be presented as images when purely decorative or essential
logic: no images of text except for logos or essential cases
fix_suggestion: Replace all images of text with actual HTML text except for logos and essential cases

title: Reflow
description: Content must reflow without horizontal scrolling at 320px width
logic: page must not require horizontal scrolling at 320 CSS pixels width
fix_suggestion: Use responsive design with flexible layouts that reflow at 320px without horizontal scrolling

title: Non-text Contrast
description: UI components and graphical objects must have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1
logic: form controls focus indicators and icons must have 3:1 contrast ratio
fix_suggestion: Ensure all UI component boundaries and graphical elements have at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors

title: Text Spacing
description: No loss of content when text spacing is adjusted
logic: content must remain readable with increased letter word and line spacing
fix_suggestion: Avoid fixed height containers and ensure content reflows when text spacing properties are overridden

title: Content on Hover or Focus
description: Content that appears on hover or focus must be dismissible persistent and hoverable
logic: tooltips and popups must be dismissible and hoverable
fix_suggestion: Ensure tooltip content can be dismissed with Escape key remains visible while hovering and does not obscure other content

title: Keyboard
description: All functionality must be available via keyboard
logic: all interactive elements must be keyboard accessible
fix_suggestion: Ensure all interactive elements can be reached and activated using only the keyboard

title: No Keyboard Trap
description: Keyboard focus must not be trapped in a component
logic: keyboard focus must be movable away from any component
fix_suggestion: Ensure users can navigate away from all components using standard keyboard keys

title: Keyboard (No Exception)
description: All functionality must be available via keyboard with no exceptions
logic: all functionality must be operable via keyboard without exception
fix_suggestion: Remove any functionality that requires a specific device path and cannot be done via keyboard

title: Character Key Shortcuts
description: Single character key shortcuts must be remappable or disableable
logic: single key shortcuts must be configurable or only active on focus
fix_suggestion: Provide a mechanism to remap or disable single character keyboard shortcuts

title: Timing Adjustable
description: Time limits must be adjustable or removable
logic: session timeouts and auto-updating content must be controllable
fix_suggestion: Provide options to turn off extend or adjust any time limits on content

title: Pause Stop Hide
description: Moving blinking scrolling or auto-updating content must be controllable
logic: animated or auto-updating content must have pause stop or hide control
fix_suggestion: Add pause stop or hide controls to all moving blinking scrolling or auto-updating content

title: No Timing
description: Timing must not be an essential part of the activity
logic: no time limits except for real-time events
fix_suggestion: Remove all time limits from content and interactions unless they are essential

title: Interruptions
description: Interruptions must be postponable or suppressible
logic: alerts and updates must be deferrable by the user
fix_suggestion: Allow users to postpone or suppress all non-emergency interruptions and updates

title: Re-authenticating
description: Data must be preserved when an authenticated session expires
logic: form data must be saved when session expires and re-authentication is required
fix_suggestion: Save user data before session expiry and restore it after re-authentication

title: Timeouts
description: Users must be warned of inactivity timeouts that could cause data loss
logic: session timeout warnings must be shown before data loss occurs
fix_suggestion: Display a warning before session timeout and provide an option to extend the session

title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
description: Content must not flash more than three times per second
logic: no content should flash more than 3 times per second
fix_suggestion: Remove or reduce flashing content to below 3 flashes per second or below the general flash threshold

title: Three Flashes
description: Content must not flash more than three times per second at all
logic: no flashing content allowed above threshold
fix_suggestion: Remove all flashing content or ensure it flashes fewer than 3 times per second

title: Animation from Interactions
description: Motion animation triggered by interaction must be disableable
logic: CSS animations triggered by user interaction must respect prefers-reduced-motion
fix_suggestion: Use the prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable or reduce animations for users who prefer it

title: Bypass Blocks
description: A mechanism must be available to bypass blocks of content
logic: page must have a skip navigation link
fix_suggestion: Add a skip to main content link at the top of the page

title: Page Titled
description: Web pages must have titles that describe topic or purpose
logic: page must have a non-empty title tag
fix_suggestion: Add a descriptive title element inside the head tag

title: Focus Order
description: Focusable components must receive focus in an order that preserves meaning
logic: focus order must be logical and meaningful
fix_suggestion: Ensure the DOM order matches the visual order so tab focus is logical

title: Link Purpose (In Context)
description: The purpose of each link must be determinable from the link text
logic: links must not use vague text like click here or read more
fix_suggestion: Replace vague link text with descriptive text that explains the link destination

title: Multiple Ways
description: More than one way must be available to locate a page within a set of pages
logic: site must have search or sitemap or navigation menu
fix_suggestion: Provide at least two ways to find pages such as a navigation menu and a search function

title: Headings and Labels
description: Headings and labels must describe topic or purpose
logic: heading hierarchy must be logical and not skip levels
fix_suggestion: Use headings in order h1 h2 h3 without skipping levels

title: Focus Visible
description: Keyboard focus indicator must be visible
logic: focused elements must have visible focus ring
fix_suggestion: Do not remove outline from focused elements and ensure focus styles are clearly visible

title: Location
description: Information about the user location within a set of pages must be available
logic: breadcrumbs or site map must indicate current location
fix_suggestion: Add breadcrumb navigation or highlight the current page in the navigation menu

title: Link Purpose (Link Only)
description: The purpose of each link must be determinable from the link text alone
logic: link text alone must describe the destination without context
fix_suggestion: Make every link text descriptive enough to understand its purpose without surrounding context

title: Section Headings
description: Section headings must be used to organize content
logic: long content must be organized with section headings
fix_suggestion: Add descriptive headings to organize content into logical sections

title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
description: Focused component must not be entirely hidden by sticky content
logic: focused elements must not be fully covered by sticky headers or footers
fix_suggestion: Ensure sticky headers and footers do not completely obscure focused elements

title: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
description: Focused component must not be hidden by any author-created content
logic: focused elements must be fully visible
fix_suggestion: Ensure no author-created content covers focused elements at all

title: Focus Appearance
description: Focus indicator must meet minimum size and contrast requirements
logic: focus indicator must be at least 2px and have 3:1 contrast
fix_suggestion: Ensure focus indicators are at least 2 CSS pixels thick and have a contrast ratio of at least 3:1

title: Pointer Gestures
description: All functionality using multipoint or path-based gestures must have a single pointer alternative
logic: swipe and pinch gestures must have single tap alternatives
fix_suggestion: Provide single-pointer alternatives for all multipoint or path-based gesture functionality

title: Pointer Cancellation
description: Functions triggered by single pointer must be cancellable
logic: click actions must be triggered on up-event not down-event
fix_suggestion: Trigger actions on the up-event and allow users to cancel by moving the pointer away before releasing

title: Label in Name
description: UI components with visible text labels must have accessible names containing the visible text
logic: aria-label must contain the visible text of the component
fix_suggestion: Ensure the accessible name of each UI component includes its visible text label

title: Motion Actuation
description: Functionality triggered by device motion must have a UI alternative
logic: shake tilt and motion gestures must have button alternatives
fix_suggestion: Provide UI controls as alternatives to device motion gestures and allow motion response to be disabled

title: Target Size (Enhanced)
description: Target size for pointer inputs must be at least 44x44 CSS pixels
logic: interactive elements must be at least 44 by 44 pixels
fix_suggestion: Ensure all interactive targets are at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels in size

title: Concurrent Input Mechanisms
description: Content must not restrict use of input modalities
logic: page must not restrict input to a single modality
fix_suggestion: Allow users to switch between input methods such as keyboard mouse and touch without restriction

title: Dragging Movements
description: All functionality using dragging must have a single pointer alternative
logic: drag and drop must have a click-based alternative
fix_suggestion: Provide a single-pointer alternative for all drag-and-drop functionality

title: Target Size (Minimum)
description: Target size must be at least 24x24 CSS pixels
logic: interactive elements must be at least 24 by 24 pixels
fix_suggestion: Ensure all interactive targets are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or have sufficient spacing

title: Language of Page
description: The default human language of each page must be programmatically determined
logic: html tag must have lang attribute
fix_suggestion: Add a lang attribute to the html tag with the correct language code

title: Language of Parts
description: The human language of each passage must be programmatically determined
logic: elements with different language content must have lang attribute
fix_suggestion: Add lang attribute to elements that contain content in a different language

title: Unusual Words
description: A mechanism must be available to identify unusual words and jargon
logic: technical terms and jargon must have definitions available
fix_suggestion: Provide a glossary or inline definitions for unusual words abbreviations and jargon

title: Abbreviations
description: A mechanism must be available to identify the expanded form of abbreviations
logic: abbreviations must use abbr element or have definitions
fix_suggestion: Use the abbr element with a title attribute to expand abbreviations on first use

title: Reading Level
description: Content requiring more than lower secondary education reading level must have a simpler alternative
logic: complex content must have a plain language summary
fix_suggestion: Provide a plain language summary or simplified version of complex content

title: Pronunciation
description: A mechanism must be available to identify pronunciation of words
logic: ambiguous words must have pronunciation guidance
fix_suggestion: Use the ruby element or provide a pronunciation guide for words where meaning depends on pronunciation

title: On Focus
description: Receiving focus must not initiate a change of context
logic: focus events must not trigger navigation or form submission
fix_suggestion: Remove any JavaScript that triggers navigation or context changes when an element receives focus

title: On Input
description: Changing a UI component setting must not automatically cause a change of context
logic: form inputs must not auto-submit or navigate on change
fix_suggestion: Remove auto-submit behavior from form inputs and require explicit user action to submit

title: Consistent Navigation
description: Navigation mechanisms must appear in the same relative order across pages
logic: navigation menus must be consistent across all pages
fix_suggestion: Ensure navigation menus appear in the same order and position on every page of the site

title: Consistent Identification
description: Components with the same functionality must be identified consistently
logic: identical functions must have consistent labels and names
fix_suggestion: Use consistent labels icons and names for components that perform the same function across pages

title: Change on Request
description: Changes of context must only be initiated by user request
logic: context changes must require explicit user action
fix_suggestion: Only trigger context changes in response to explicit user actions and provide a preference setting

title: Consistent Help
description: Help mechanisms must appear in the same relative location across pages
logic: help links and contact info must be consistently placed
fix_suggestion: Place help mechanisms such as contact links chatbots and FAQs in the same location on every page

title: Error Identification
description: If an input error is detected it must be identified and described to the user
logic: form errors must be clearly identified and described
fix_suggestion: Display clear error messages that identify the field and describe the problem

title: Labels or Instructions
description: Labels or instructions must be provided when content requires user input
logic: all form inputs must have visible labels or instructions
fix_suggestion: Add visible label elements or placeholder instructions to all form inputs

title: Error Suggestion
description: If an input error is detected suggestions for correction must be provided
logic: form validation errors must include correction suggestions
fix_suggestion: Provide specific suggestions for correcting input errors when the correction is known

title: Error Prevention (Legal Financial Data)
description: Submissions that cause legal or financial commitments must be reversible checkable or confirmable
logic: important form submissions must have review confirm or undo step
fix_suggestion: Add a confirmation step review page or undo mechanism for forms with legal or financial consequences

title: Help
description: Context-sensitive help must be available
logic: complex forms must have context-sensitive help available
fix_suggestion: Provide context-sensitive help text or links to help documentation for complex form fields

title: Error Prevention (All)
description: All form submissions must be reversible checkable or confirmable
logic: all form submissions must have review confirm or undo step
fix_suggestion: Add confirmation review or undo mechanisms to all form submissions

title: Redundant Entry
description: Information previously entered must be auto-populated or available for selection
logic: forms must not require re-entry of previously provided information
fix_suggestion: Auto-populate fields with previously entered information or allow users to select from prior entries

title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
description: Authentication must not require cognitive function tests unless alternatives are provided
logic: login must not require solving puzzles or memorizing without alternatives
fix_suggestion: Provide alternatives to cognitive tests in authentication such as copy-paste support or email magic links

title: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
description: Authentication must not require cognitive function tests at all
logic: login must not require any cognitive function test
fix_suggestion: Remove all cognitive function tests from authentication flows entirely

title: Parsing
description: HTML must have complete start and end tags and no duplicate attributes
logic: html must be well formed with no parsing errors
fix_suggestion: Fix HTML markup errors using a validator like the W3C validator

title: Name Role Value
description: All UI components must have name role and value that can be determined programmatically
logic: interactive elements must have accessible name and role
fix_suggestion: Add aria-label or aria-labelledby to interactive elements that lack visible text labels

title: Status Messages
description: Status messages must be programmatically determinable without receiving focus
logic: status and error messages must use ARIA live regions
fix_suggestion: Use aria-live regions or role=status to announce dynamic status messages to screen readers
